conventions.q: eta + eps H, eps = kappa, H = h (lowered, symmetric); affine parametrisation
conventions.density: L_GG = sqrt(-g) g^{mn}(G^a_{mb} G^b_{na} - G^a_{mn} G^b_{ab})
conventions.boundary_identity: sqrt(-g) R - L_GG = - d_mu B^mu,  B^mu = sqrt(-g)(g^{mu nu} G^l_{nu l} - g^{l nu} G^mu_{l nu})
conventions.ell_k: -2 [eps^k] L_GG ; S_EH = sum_k kappa^{k-2} int ell_k (integrated, compact support)
conventions.IBP: total derivatives dropped only inside the integrated action (orientation of the dropped divergence irrelevant)
conventions.polarization: V4[h1..h4] = [t1 t2 t3 t4] ell_4(sum t_i h_i) = D^4 ell_4(0)[h1..h4] (unnormalised); normalised symmetric form = V4/4!; Feynman vertex i kappa^2 V4; D02 graph symmetry factor 1/2

polarization.convention: V4[h1..h4] = [t1 t2 t3 t4] ell_4(sum t_i h_i) = D^4 ell_4(0)[h1..h4] (unnormalised); normalised symmetric form = V4/4!; Feynman vertex i kappa^2 V4; D02 graph symmetry factor 1/2
polarization.definition: V4[h1,h2,h3,h4] := [t1 t2 t3 t4] ell_4(sum_i t_i h_i) = D^4 ell_4(0)[h1,h2,h3,h4]
polarization.normalisation: UNnormalised fourth variation; the normalised symmetric 4-linear form is V4/4! (not used)

where_factors_enter.1/4!: only in S2 = (1/4!) V4[h,h,h,h]; cancelled by the 4! leg assignments
